text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's done! You really learn so 
much once you actually try making it...

One day, I spotted Kiseki carrying food. 
On the table was a massive bone-in meat, a 
five-patty burger... and more.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, spot on...! Truth is, my next 
work is planned to be a cooking manga, so 
I'm studying up for it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
See, having that sense of reality—like the 
skill and mindset you have while making 
it—is essential!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Take this, for example—the 'Four Seas 
Conqueror Ramen'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Miso, soy sauce, tonkotsu, and salt... 
Combined all together into the ultimate 
ramen! Bon appétit!"

Taking up the offer, I had just one bite 
of the ramen, and—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thank you so much! Hehe, all that 
research really paid off~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Especially that reaction of yours—it's the 
best! Your smile after taking a bite, the 
sparkle in your eyes... It really shows 
just how delicious it is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I get it. The reaction when eating 
is an essential part of cooking manga 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've gotta experience it too! 
...Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...! Four distinct flavors 
blending together harmoniously across the 
palate...! A true ramen quartet...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —It's DELICIOUSSSS!!
choice_data_list: Oh, I can feel that burning passion...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, I shouted without even 
thinking...! Eating delicious manga food 
really makes you react just like a manga 
character...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of reaction they'll 
have when they actually eat the other 
dishes...!? Alright, I've gotta test out a 
whole bunch!
choice_data_list: Let's observe how different people react.
Eat a lot, and learn a lot!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed! Variety is important, after 
all... I'll go call out to them!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oooooh—!! Awesome! I've seen this kind 
of meat in manga! I've always wanted to 
take a huge bite out of one~♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah! What a huge takoyaki...! Wow, these 
dishes are all so unique.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, eat as much as you want! Show me 
how delicious it tastes to both of you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Aiming for a cooking manga that will 
go down in history...! Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! T-This tropical flavor is...! The 
melting fruit pulp and the juicy 
sweetness! A tropical breeze is sweeping 
right through my mouth—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can certainly hear it... the sound 
of waves! Ah, what a wonderful vacation!
choice_data_list:
Amazing! It feels like we're really in the 
tropics!

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Kiseki tasted all sorts of 
dishes to learn how to react when eating.
